title: Luteolin Exhibits Anxiolytic and Antidepressant Potential in Parkinson's Disease Rat: Antioxidant and Anti-Inflammatory Effects.
authors: She, Ruifang; Zhang, Zhaoting; Han, Miaomiao; Zhao, Dapeng; Li, Xiangting; Zhou, Jian; Chang, Yanyan; Zhang, Xinping; Li, Xiaohong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究木犀草素在帕金森病大鼠中的抗焦虑抗抑郁作用及抗氧化抗炎机制，分子对接仅涉及小分子与NF-kB/NLRP3蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is accompanied by a complex array of nonmotor and motor manifestations. The exploration of anti-inflammatory and antioxidant active ingredient as potential therapeutic interventions in PD-associated mood alterations has gained significant attention. This study aimed to assess the antidepressant and anxiolytic properties of luteolin (LTN), a potent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory component, using a 6-hydroxydopamine (6-OHDA)-induced animal model of PD. Rats were administered LTN (10, 25, and 50 mg/kg, per oral) and fluoxetine (10 mg/kg/per oral) over a 28-day period. Behavioral tests were employed to estimate the depression- and anxiety-like behaviors. Rats treated with LTN exhibited significant improvement in 6-OHDA-induced mood alterations, as per behavioral tests. Additionally, LTN treatment led to increased hippocampal levels of catalase and superoxide dismutase, and a reduction in malondialdehyde. LTN downregulated the gene expression of nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB)/nod-like receptor (NLR) pyrin domain-containing 3 (NLRP3) axis components, including NF-kappaB, NLRP3, ASC, and Caspase1 and reduced the protein level of pro-inflammatory cytokines, including interleukin (IL)-6, interleukin (IL)-1beta, and tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha), in addition to augmenting the protein levels of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6. Furthermore, LTN exhibited an upregulatory effect on the anti-inflammatory cytokine IL-10 within the hippocampus of 6-OHDA-induced PD rats. Also, molecular docking showed higher affinity between LTN and NF-kappaB/NLRP3 axis components. These findings highlight the potential anxiolytic and antidepressant impacts of LTN through its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory mechanisms against 6-OHDA-induced alterations in a rat PD model.
abstract_zh: 帕金森病（Parkinson's disease, PD）伴随一系列复杂的非运动及运动表现。探索抗炎和抗氧化活性成分作为PD相关情绪改变潜在治疗干预手段已引起广泛关注。本研究旨在利用6-羟基多巴胺（6-hydroxydopamine, 6-OHDA）诱导的PD动物模型，评估木犀草素（luteolin, LTN）——一种强效抗氧化和抗炎成分——的抗抑郁和抗焦虑特性。大鼠接受LTN（10、25和50 mg/kg，口服）和氟西汀（10 mg/kg，口服）治疗，持续28天。采用行为学测试评估抑郁样和焦虑样行为。根据行为学测试，接受LTN治疗的大鼠在6-OHDA诱导的情绪改变中表现出显著改善。此外，LTN治疗导致海马中过氧化氢酶和超氧化物歧化酶水平升高，并降低丙二醛水平。LTN下调核因子κB（nuclear factor kappa B, NF-kappaB）/NOD样受体（nod-like receptor, NLR）含吡啉结构域3（NLRP3）轴成分（包括NF-kappaB、NLRP3、ASC和Caspase1）的基因表达，并降低促炎细胞因子（包括白细胞介素（interleukin, IL）-6、白细胞介素（IL）-1β和肿瘤坏死因子α（tumor necrosis factor alpha, TNF-alpha））的蛋白水平，同时增强TNF-alpha、IL-1β和IL-6的蛋白水平。此外，LTN在6-OHDA诱导的PD大鼠海马中对抗炎细胞因子IL-10表现出上调作用。同时，分子对接显示LTN与NF-kappaB/NLRP3轴成分之间具有较高亲和力。这些发现强调了LTN通过其抗氧化和抗炎机制，在PD大鼠模型中对抗6-OHDA诱导的改变，发挥潜在的抗焦虑和抗抑郁作用。
